about: Chatbot-style questions for tracing how the agent turns a question into primo_search calls and how it reports the results. Known-item questions use titles from benchmark/ground_truth.json (gt_id), so held/absent is already verified. reference_args is a hand-written, correctly shaped primo_search call for the same intent, run without the model as a baseline; null when the question has no single right search (topics, reading lists).
